message: Any non-interactive dispatch MUST close/redirect stdin (`</dev/null`). Omitting it can hang with zero output, which is indistinguishable from a slow model.

Non-interactive `claude -p` with acceptEdits + no TTY + a Bash-heavy prompt can deadlock on an unanswerable shell-permission prompt; run it sandboxed with `--dangerously-skip-permissions` or ensure the prompt needs no shell approval.
